description: Aider-polyglot style (JavaScript): implement an atomic JSON-patch-like engine (add, remove, replace, move, copy, test) over JSON-pointer paths from a stub and an instructions file - ~0/~1 escape decoding order, the '-' array-end token only where allowed, strict array index syntax, own-property semantics (inherited names and __proto__), move index semantics after removal, no aliasing of input or patch values, and an error naming the failing operation index with the original document unchanged. The node:test suite is the acceptance bar and the post-turn verifier gives a repair round with the test output, like aider's second try.
